description: FHIR R4 Observation resource — measurements and simple assertions made about a patient, device or other subject. Covers lab results, vital signs, and clinical findings.

fields.label: Resource ID
fields.description: The logical id of the resource, as used in the URL for the resource.

fields.label: Identifier
fields.description: A unique identifier assigned to this observation.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: The status of the result value. Values: registered | preliminary | final | amended | corrected | cancelled | entered-in-error | unknown.

fields.label: Category
fields.description: A code that classifies the general type of observation being made. e.g. vital-signs | laboratory | imaging | exam | survey | therapy | activity.

fields.label: Code
fields.description: Describes what was observed. Sometimes called 'Name'. Coded using LOINC or SNOMED CT.

fields.label: Subject
fields.description: The patient, or group of patients, location, device, organization, procedure or practitioner this observation is about.

fields.label: Encounter
fields.description: The healthcare event (e.g. a patient and healthcare provider interaction) during which this observation is made.

fields.label: Effective Date Time
fields.description: The time or time-period the observed value is asserted as being true.

fields.label: Issued
fields.description: The date and time this version of the observation was made available to providers.

fields.label: Performer
fields.description: Who was responsible for asserting the observed value as 'true'.

fields.label: Value Quantity
fields.description: The information determined as a result of making the observation — numeric value with unit (e.g. 98.6 degF, 7.2 g/dL).

fields.label: Value String
fields.description: The information determined as a result of making the observation — free text.

fields.label: Value Codeable Concept
fields.description: The information determined as a result of making the observation — coded value.

fields.label: Data Absent Reason
fields.description: Provides a reason why the expected value in the element Observation.value[x] is missing.

fields.label: Interpretation
fields.description: A categorical assessment of an observation value. e.g. High, Low, Normal.

fields.label: Note
fields.description: Comments about the observation or the results.

fields.label: Reference Range
fields.description: Guidance on how to interpret the value by comparison to a normal or recommended range.

fields.label: Component
fields.description: Some observations have multiple component observations. These component observations are expressed as separate code value pairs that share the same attributes.
